== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[He Hasn't Come Back Yet (Japanese ESB Two-Player)|He Hasn't Come Back Yet]] from [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=100670 Star Wars Collectors Archive item 100670], [https://theswca.com/imgup/100670-1.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(90, 50, 680, 930)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b08bdf386f23d584c00a936a9c73513078f2aae07fd7d0629d627259024b4bb1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
